patterns.what_worked: Re-fetching the six raw APL files from wowsims/*/master (every group expanded) instead of trusting the gap analysis settled the conditions the bench had only summarised - it caught four divergences (the Explosive Trap is gated on a DOT not a cooldown, the Immolation Trap is a melee-range row, the Era Serpent's early-refresh window, the WotLK Kill Shot having no execute condition). The mutation proofs caught two pins that passed with a broken implementation until the fixtures were tightened (the player's aspect buff UP, the target's Hunter's Mark UP).
patterns.what_was_hard: The hunter's guide-slot contract was 'six of the six allowed' and the utility layer needs up to thirteen slots - the task's 'the guide can light it' forced the contract open, and the pinned slot counts plus the frame-count pins moved with it. The scenario's default state ('every cooldown ready') means the family's top APL row now leads, so the offline verdicts moved (the WotLK -> the Silencing Shot, the Era -> the Rapid Fire) - defensible, but it moved a lot of shipped pins.
patterns.skill_gap: The edit tool's exact-match behaviour silently joined lines twice when an oldString ended in a newline; both times the join had to be found by reading the file back. Anchors should end on a complete line.
